title: Angling Edge Adventures
description: Angling Edge Adventures puts destination fishing front and center, traveling to world-class waters across the Midwest and Canada. Hosted by the Lindner team, each episode highlights outstanding fisheries while showing anglers how to break down new water and capitalize on peak seasonal opportunities. Grounded in the proven Angling Edge approach, the series blends travel, exploration, and real-world instruction-combining time-tested fundamentals with the most effective tools and technology.

title: Arkansas Great Outdoors
description: A new program will provide even better fishing experiences in Arkansas: Legacy Lunker. Plus, a visit to ICAST for new product reviews.

description: Host Mike Frisch catches not one, but two personal best walleyes while fishing Lake Oahe in South Dakota!

title: Jimmy Houston Outdoors
description: Jimmy Houston has quite the adventure on his fishing expeditions! Traveling from Oklahoma up to Canada and down to South America offers him a diverse range of fishing experiences. And with catches like largemouth bass, striped bass, smallmouth bass, crappie, catfish, and golden dorado, there's no shortage of excitement. His show is a must see for any fishing enthusiast, offering a variety of fishing action across different locations and species.

title: Fishing With Roland Martin
description: Roland and his granddaughter Hilary throw frogs into the shallow reed clumps to catch large Mouth Bass.

title: Bill Dance Outdoors
description: Get ready for Bill to prove the myth that bigger, slow-moving baits do in fact catch bigger bass.

title: The Fish Guyz
description: Capt. Lain and EB III start the day strong in the Contender Bay Boat with giant blackfin tuna, then pick up Joe Mallazzo to chase sailfish. The Guyz stop by Plant a Million Corals for an update. Chef Cat uses the fresh tuna to make amazing sushi rolls.

title: Spear Life

title: Catching Bass With Dustin Wilks
description: Accomplished angler Dustin Wilks fishes various bass fishing locations and teaches how to find and catch more fish. Loaded with fish catches, Catching Bass with Dustin Wilks is a show that is action-packed and shows the viewer numerous techniques for catching bass. Dustin's straightforward approach coupled with his whimsical demeanor makes Catching Bass with Dustin Wilks the perfect teaching platform for anyone to be successful in bass fishing.
